prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions tended to overestimate positive impact in early rounds, but underestimated positive gains in round 3 winning tests.
sign_in hint changes have shown no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests.
Evidence remains thin for adoption redesign as its 2 tests do not agree (one won, one had no clear effect).
Evidence remains thin for home wait_info as its 2 tests do not agree (one had no clear effect, one won).
Evidence is still thin for choose_path copy, choose_path layout, finish copy, finish new_flow, finish new_screen, home notification, and sign_in reorder, as each has only one test so far.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Custom Pet Creation Stage: Redesign pick_friend screen layout into a stage workspace with live companion animation and interactive choice cards. (why: Adoption has a high drop-off rate of 33.8% and long mean time (1017s), with support reporting custom pet generation issues.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Companion Preview Screen: Add a dedicated controls preview screen before home_intro showcasing keyboard shortcuts and tray icon controls. (why: Finish step drops 35.2% of users and support emails frequently cite confusion on how to control or hide the desktop pet.)
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive Story Mode Onboarding Flow: Transform the story screen into a story scroll layout with interactive companion personality choices. (why: The choose_path step has a 20.4% drop rate and a long mean duration of 514s.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Account Sign-In Flow Reorder: Move sign_in to occur after waiting so users adopt and preview their pet before authenticating. (why: Sign_in drops 27.1% of users early before they feel invested in their chosen desktop pet.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync & Pet Saved Reassurance Hint: Display a hint explaining that signing in links your desktop pet to your cloud profile so progress is never lost. (why: Support logs show 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing back in.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Waiting Status Stream: Show detailed real-time rendering status and animated progress updates on the waiting screen. (why: Home wait step has a high mean time of 2336s and 3 support emails reported desktop render failures.)
6: [adoption, layout] Grid View Pet Trait Browser: Switch pick_friend to a grid layout displaying all available pet styles side-by-side. (why: Adoption has a 33.8% drop-off rate and high completion time (1017s mean).)
7: [home, notification] Background Render System Notification: Add option to send system notification when the pet finished spawning while app is minimized. (why: Long wait time mean (2336s) causes users to multitask and forget the desktop pet launch.)
8: [finish, copy] Desktop Quick Launch Controls Guidance: Clarify post-onboarding controls in home_intro copy to explain tray icon behavior and drag commands. (why: Support received multiple complaints about not knowing how to reveal or interact with pet post-setup.)
